messages:
Avni (PM): Quick thread: we need a trimmed launch gate for console observability. Goal: give customers immediate visibility into cost drivers + a fast path to triage errors. My proposed MVP cut: (A) cost-by-model dashboard template, (B) per-route trace sampling toggle, (C) compact error summary card with trace link for Private. Thoughts?
Tom (Eng): +1. Technical gotcha: linking traces requires a request_id flow. Hosted default should avoid request_id for privacy; we can use sampled request_ids for linking. Estimate: 5 dev-days for telemetry + UI hook.
Rashid (SRE): Agree. Operational constraints: default sampling 1-5% for hosted; add server-side caps. Also we need a reliable fallback when trace backend lags  show cached rollups.
Lila (Design): UX note: error card must let users filter by timeframe and expand to show top 3 stack traces. Also when enabling higher sampling show inline cost estimate and a confirmation.
Marta (Data): Schema suggestion for cost events: route, model_id, tokens_in, tokens_out, cached_tokens, customer_id (hashed), timestamp. For hosted no raw request_id. Aggregates precomputed daily for performance.
Tom (Eng): Implementation plan: emit tokens_out and cached_tokens from the serving layer; add a sampling flag for request_id. Runtime config example:
trace_sampling: default: 0.02
 per_route: /v1/generate:0.1
Will enforce max_sampling_hosted: 0.5 by config.
Rashid (SRE): Launch criteria proposal: templates render p95 <1.5s on staging with 7d rollups; sampling UI persists config and runtime honors it; error card surfaces top-5 anomalies and links work for Private. Add alarms: query latency up 25% or token spend delta >20% -> halt rollout.
Avni (PM): Prioritizing: sprint 1 dashboards + token telemetry (HIGH), sprint 2 sampling API + UI (MED), sprint 3 error card + private-only trace linking (LOW). Canary: 3% orgs for 48h. I'll update the roadmap doc and schedule a check-in Friday 11am. ci-bot: build queued: obs-console/feature -> staging.
Tom (Eng): I'll open the runtime PR today, small spike for sampling enforcement first.
Lila (Design): I'll deliver mocks by EOD tomorrow.
Marta (Data): I'll prepare rollup jobs and a brief on expected storage/cost impact.
Avni (PM): Thanks everyone. If anyone wants to move items between cuts reply here. :thumbsup:
